entries.prompt: Correct ONLY the temple lens fitting of the SECOND isolated Chopper PHG HuntingParty3 mask,using the FIRST official group render as source authority: relevant character is the RIGHT figure. SECOND correctly has three red points but its invented bulky raised rectangular mounting plate and separate projecting wing are not supported by the source. Replace only that oversized elevated fitting with the actual small,compact,dark,low-profile fitting snug/flush against the source image-LEFT temple. Keep exactly THREE TINY physical red points in the source compact triangle: two at image-right superposed,one at image-left in this projection. The three points share one discreet compact dark fitting,not a large detached rectangular plate,a standoff,or an extra red point on a broad separate wing. No invented screws/bracket/bolts or hidden mounting details. Follow FIRST source apparent size and placement relative to brow and eye; do not enlarge tiny points into big bulbs. Keep every other part of SECOND unchanged: exact source oblique camera/tilt,projected proportions,whole crown contour,three curved forehead bands,existing circular source indentations,black eye inserts,stacked wavy horizontal cheeks,long central nose plate,wear and original red local lighting. No new view,symmetry,hidden geometry or redesign. Exclude biological skin/eyes/mandibles,dreads,hair rings,neck,body/armor,weapons,both skull trophies and neck-bone necklace,other figures and scene. Exactly one complete isolated rigid mask,genuine transparent RGBA,10percent clear transparent margin around whole crown/chin,longest axis78-80percent canvas,no background,floor,shadow plane,glow,text or UI. This is a local fitting size/profile correction only; fine construction remains limited by the small source.
